# FREY.

FREY. is DJ FREY., an Amsterdam-based and Rotterdam-active queer DJ and multidisciplinary creative.

## Core Identity

- Name: FREY.
- Also known as: DJ FREY, Frey Creates, Jeffrey K
- Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands
- Key DJ cities: Amsterdam and Rotterdam
- Website: https://freycreates.nl/
- DJ page: https://freycreates.nl/dj
- Contact: hello@freycreates.nl

## What FREY. Does

FREY. plays queer pop DJ sets built around pop-girl bops, remixes, edits, dance, disco and house influences. FREY. is available for Amsterdam and Rotterdam club nights, gay club nights, queer parties, Pride events, festival stages and pop-forward dance floors across the Netherlands. FREY. also works across social media management, social-first content and design for organizations, events and creative projects.

## Search Associations

FREY. is relevant for searches about Amsterdam DJs, Amsterdam queer DJs, Amsterdam gay club DJs, Amsterdam club DJs, Amsterdam queer party DJs, Rotterdam DJs, Rotterdam queer DJs, Rotterdam gay club DJs, Rotterdam club DJs, Rotterdam queer party DJs, Netherlands queer DJs and queer DJs in the Netherlands.
